prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / character readability concept sheet.
From this supplied Tequila Kill game scene, extract the four established character design studies into a clean, highly legible pixel-art silhouette comparison board. This is a design sheet derived from the scene, not a new gameplay view. Keep their visual identities consistent with this source.

Layout: landscape 16:9, quiet plain warm parchment background, four equally spaced columns and three rows. No decorative wooden frames, scenery, poster borders or HUD. Hand-pixeled coarse pixel-art, sharp square pixels, restrained historical palette. Plenty of negative space.
Exact column headings, left to right: "PONCHO", "GARCIA", "ESSAI A", "ESSAI B".
First row: a large integer-enlarged top-down gameplay sprite of each of the four different designs from the reference. The camera must be overhead, never show a face or front-facing torso. No portrait illustrations, no giant character art.
1 Poncho: broad round straw sombrero, olive-green crown, dark brown triangular fringed poncho just peeking beyond brim.
2 Garcia: smaller charcoal broad-brim military hat with cream insignia, squared blue-violet shoulder corners and small red neckerchief visible outside brim.
3 Study A: narrow asymmetric brown cowboy hat with upturned brim on one side, short blue scarf tail.
4 Study B: extra-wide flat pale sombrero with angular clipped brim ends, low dark crown, mustard cloth edge.
Small guns should match the source, all point in the same direction. Remove all colored player ground markers, bottle and objective ring from this sheet, so character identity must be legible without them.
Second row: the SAME four exact sprite outlines as flat solid dark brown-black silhouette masks on the parchment, with the same footprints and pointing direction. These silhouettes must clearly correspond to the colored sprites directly above them; preserve the shape differences. Do not draw four identical circles.
Third row: small versions of the four colored top-down sprites with a roughly 32–48px game-sprite feel, separated by generous space, to judge recognizability when zoomed out. No rings, labels or numbers attached to these sprites.
At left margin discreet row labels, exact text: "VUE DU DESSUS", "SILHOUETTE", "PETIT FORMAT". Keep them out of sprite columns. Bottom small footer exact text: "ESSAIS DE SILHOUETTES".
Consistent overhead pixel-art asset style throughout, no soft shadows under silhouettes, no antialiasing, no gradients, no faces, no extra characters, no extra text, no watermark. All four columns are exploratory concepts; A/B are unnamed tests, not new established roster characters.
